title: BetterRockets
description: Gives you more inventory space by storing rockets in a boostpack and using them to fly with an elytra.
body:
Gives you more inventory space by storing rockets in a boostpack and using them to fly with an elytra.

Press **F** (Swap Item Key) to boost yourself

Version 1.1 uses rockets from your inventory or ender chest.
Version 2.0 introduces a Boostpack that stores all your rockets and can be filled with `/rockets store`.
